_comment: Pinned exceptions for scripts/validation/dead-components.mjs (task #365). Every entry is a file that is UNREACHABLE from client/index.html and server/ — pre-existing dead code found when the gate was introduced. The gate checks all of client/src/ and shared/ (task #370 widened it past components/; server/ files are roots and *.d.ts is ambient, so both stay out of scope). This list is MECHANICALLY shrink-only: the gate carries a frozen manifest of exactly these paths and fails on any entry outside it, so adding or substituting entries here does nothing but fail the gate (allowlist-growth). The only allowed edit is REMOVING an entry together with deleting its dead file; stale pins (file reachable again, or deleted with the entry left behind) also fail. All 22 original pins were resolved by the deletion sweep (task #369), and the five dead hooks/lib files the widened scope exposed were deleted too (task #370) rather than pinned — so the universe is empty and no entry here can ever be valid again.
